problem.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array

case.scenario: The code uses right = mid - 1 when nums[mid] is smaller than nums[right], which can discard mid even when mid is the minimum.
expectedCoachFocus: Explain why mid cannot be excluded when nums[mid] < nums[right].
Suggest right = mid under the invariant that the minimum remains inside [left, right].

firstFailedCase.label: mid itself can be the minimum

testResults.label: mid itself can be the minimum
